newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB, former Nomura heads to be called to parliament.
newsitem.headline: DKB, former Nomura heads to be called to parliament.

text.p: A key committee of the Lower House of Japan's parliament plans to summon Katsuhiko Kondo, outgoing president of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB), and Yoshihisa Tabuchi, former president of Nomura Securities Co Ltd, to speak before the committee on June 5, a committee official said on Tuesday.
An official decision on summoning the two to parliament will be made on Thursday, he added.
Both companies are mired in a racketeer scandal.

Separately, a committee of parliament's Upper House will summon DKB's Kondo on Wednesday, along with Kuniji Miyazaki, an adviser to DKB, and Nomura's former chairman, Setsuya Tabuchi, and former president, Hideo Sakamaki.
